description: NIST MBE PMI combined test case 02, the AP203 geometry-only edition (ADR-0026 §1): the solid is refused for a real gap, the surface body beside it as a surface
licence: NIST: "The test cases, CAD models, and STEP files can be used without any restrictions."

refused.why: edge #11056 lies 0.0112 from a face it bounds, past the model's max_tolerance of 0.01: closing that is sewing, which is healing (ADR-0025 §4); Open CASCADE carries the part at vertex and edge tolerances of up to 0.108
